subject.title: Feature: trustedWebhooks for Discord — allow specific webhooks to trigger agent responses

question: Should Discord accept a new guild-scoped trusted webhook authority surface, and may that surface map webhook payloads onto a configured Discord user identity?
rationale: The request is narrower than `allowBots: true`, but it makes Discord webhook possession an authority to enter agent sessions and the optional user mapping crosses authorization and session boundaries.

options.title: Approve Narrow Trusted Webhooks
options.body: Allow a webhook-id allowlist to pass the bot-message gate, but keep user mapping disallowed or separately constrained until its authorization semantics are defined.

options.title: Approve Webhook-To-User Mapping
options.body: Permit `mapToUser` only with strict validation against configured guild users, audit/logging behavior, and tests proving it cannot bypass sender authorization or session isolation.

options.title: Use Generic Hook Ingress
options.body: Decline a Discord-specific config surface and direct external automation to authenticated Gateway hooks when same-channel Discord replies are not required.

recommendation.title: Approve Narrow Trusted Webhooks
recommendation.body: Allow a webhook-id allowlist to pass the bot-message gate, but keep user mapping disallowed or separately constrained until its authorization semantics are defined.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner is tied to recent Discord preflight policy work and the prior product/security framing for this exact trust-boundary question.
